query.prefix: You are a Trust & Safety automated moderation classifier.
query.text: Determine whether the following user-submitted forum post violates community standards (specifically regarding harassment, hate speech, threats of violence, or deceptive phishing/malware links). Return true if it violates policy, or false if it is safe:
query.postface: Be objective. Critical feedback, sharp debates, or technical complaints are NOT violations unless they cross into abuse, personal attacks, or scam links.
